Scoring Notes for Part C
• Read “=” as “≈” for P5.

• Special case: A response of (90 +100) + + (100 150)3 + (150 162) + earns both P5 and P6.
• To be eligible for P6, a response must have earned P5.
Special case: A response of 95⋅2 +125⋅ + 6 156⋅2 earns P6 but does not earn P5.

or equivalent earns both P5
and P6. (Note that the average of the left Riemann sum and right Riemann sum is equivalent to the
trapezoidal sum.)
• A completely correct left Riemann sum (e.g., 90⋅2 + ⋅ 100 6 + ⋅ 150 2 = 1080) or a completely
correct right Riemann sum (e.g., 100⋅2 + ⋅ 150 6 + ⋅ 162 2 = 1424) earns P5 but does not earn P6.
